featured_reviews.name: Deeshika Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
She is truly the best teacher.

Let me start with how I came across her class.

I wanted to learn a two-wheeler, and she was the nearest instructor to my location. When I called her, she suggested I start with a 1-month course so that I could learn properly. She also has a 15-day training program where she teaches the basics of riding a scooty, but I enrolled for the 30-day course because I genuinely wanted to learn. I had made up my mind to be a disciplined student and learn properly from her.

She is extremely patient and always points out mistakes, but in a way that helps you rectify them and improve. She handled me so well for the first 12 days, and boosting my confidence was her core strength. She is very assertive with her words, which really helps students who are scared or nervous.

Within 15 days, I started riding on my own. Then we had lessons about traffic rules, and sometimes a little chit-chat while watching highway riders, since the highway is next to where we learn. I was super excited to learn scooty, and she was equally excited to teach me.

Her day always starts with a cheerful “GOOD MORNING!!!”, which is honestly so sweet, and that’s something I’m going to miss a lot.

Talking about her team coordination — they are really good at it. Her teammates are always there to support, guide, and observe where students are going wrong. They help at every step. She truly has a very dedicated team.

When I started my classes, it was raining, but we still continued because I wanted the experience of learning how to ride during monsoons.

In 20 days, I learned how to ride well, and then I got my learning license through her. I waited eagerly because I wanted to ride on the highway. I was scared, but she built my confidence so strongly. Since I really wanted to learn, she sat behind me and took me to the highway almost 4 times. She was always there with me, sitting behind, guiding me, boosting my confidence, and correcting my mistakes throughout.

She is like a voice at your back:
“Do this… do that… see you’re making a mistake… next time correct it.”

And in 30 days, I learned to ride really well.

Thank you, Roshni Ma’am, for teaching me. It truly means a lot. ❤️

featured_reviews.name: sayli tate
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bharti Ma'am is best instructor 🌹🫶🏻

I would like to begin by sharing how I first learned about her classes.

I had always wanted to learn how to ride a two-wheeler, but due to my short height , I constantly harbored a sense of apprehension. Nevertheless, I was determined to learn, and—quite by coincidence—she turned out to be the instructor available closest to my home. When I called her, she advised me to enroll in a one-month course so that I could fully master the skill. She also offers a 15-day training program covering the basics of scooter riding; however, I opted for the 45-day course because I had a strong desire to truly learn this skill with proficiency.

The training began with the absolute basics—understanding the controls, maintaining balance, maintaining proper body posture, and developing road awareness. Bharti Ma'am explained every single detail with immense patience. What I appreciated most about her teaching style was the emphasis she placed on safety. Roshni Ma'am is extremely patient, and she always points out our mistakes; yet, she does so in a manner that enables you to correct those errors and foster your own progress. The way she guided me during the first 10 to 12 days was truly commendable; her greatest strength lies in her ability to boost a person's self-confidence. There is a certain firmness in her instructions—a quality that proves particularly beneficial for students who are a bit nervous or hesitant by nature.

In just 20 to 25 days, I began riding the scooter independently. After that, we went over the traffic rules, and occasionally—while observing the vehicles passing by on the highway—we would engage in lighthearted conversation, as our training venue is situated right alongside the main road. I was extremely eager to learn how to ride a scooter, and she was just as enthusiastic about teaching me.

Speaking of the coordination within their team—they are truly exceptional in this regard. Their colleagues are always prompt and ever-ready to offer help and guidance. They keep a keen eye on exactly where students are making mistakes, providing assistance at every stage. Their entire team is truly dedicated and conscientious.

When I first started my classes, I was quite nervous; being short in height , I had always harbored a fear of riding. However, "Ma'am" showed immense faith in me.

In just 20 to 25 days, I became proficient at riding the scooter. Ma'am and I even rode the scooter together (double-seat) on the highway. I felt a bit apprehensive at first; however, she bolstered my confidence so firmly that my fear vanished completely. Sitting behind me, she guided me, boosted my self-assurance, and corrected my mistakes throughout the entire journey. It felt exactly as if a voice right behind you were giving you instructions:

“Do this... do that... look, you’re making a mistake here... make sure to correct it next time.”

And in just 45 days, I had completely mastered it.

Thank you for teaching me, Bharti Ma'am. You are best ❤️
